name: GRASP
description: A large-scale grid-based benchmark consisting of 16,000 environments designed to evaluate commonsense spatial reasoning by requiring agents to solve an energy collection problem under various grid settings, energy distributions, agent constraints, and obstacle configurations.
reputation: A new specialized benchmark for commonsense spatial reasoning that is not yet widely adopted as a community standard.
notes: Evaluates planning and spatial reasoning in grid environments; compares classic baselines and advanced LLMs; highlights challenges for LLMs in spatial reasoning.
